figures.title: Actual and projected display-backlight configurations
figures.summary: Panel a and the white triangle in b concern the actual separate green/red-film backlight. The dashed black triangle is a projected alternative-emitter gamut. Panels c/d show a separate mixed-film prototype without optimized white balance. These configurations retain distinct performance scopes.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
